#!/bin/sh

base=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd) || exit 1
maildir=$base/Maildir
umask 022

mkdir -p "$maildir/tmp" \
    "$maildir/accounts/new" \
    "$maildir/support/new" \
    "$maildir/general/new" || exit 1

tmp=$(mktemp "$maildir/tmp/deliver.XXXXXXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3 15
cat > "$tmp" || exit 1

department=$(awk '
{
    line = $0
    sub(/\r$/, "", line)
    if (line == "")
        exit

    if (line ~ /^[ \t]/) {
        if (in_department) {
            sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", line)
            value = value " " line
        }
        next
    }

    in_department = 0
    colon = index(line, ":")
    if (!colon)
        next

    name = tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1))
    gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", name)
    if (name == "x-department") {
        value = substr(line, colon + 1)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", value)
        in_department = 1
    }
}
END {
    gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", value)
    print tolower(value)
}
' "$tmp") || exit 1

case "$department" in
    accounts) newdir=$maildir/accounts/new ;;
    support)  newdir=$maildir/support/new ;;
    *)        newdir=$maildir/general/new ;;
esac

stamp=$(date +%s) || exit 1
host=$(hostname 2>/dev/null | sed 's/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/_/g')
[ -n "$host" ] || host=node
counter=0
while :
do
    destination=$newdir/$stamp.$$.$counter.$host
    if ln "$tmp" "$destination" 2>/dev/null; then
        break
    fi
    [ -f "$destination" ] || exit 1
    counter=$(expr "$counter" + 1) || exit 1
done

rm -f "$tmp"
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
exit 0
